# HarborChart class (final)

A chart is a container for layers. Give it to a [ChartViewController](https://docs.example.com/flutter/api/harbor_maps/ChartViewController-class.html) to draw it.

- **Inheritance:**
  - [Object](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-core/Object-class.html)
  - HarborChart

## Constructors

- [`HarborChart(Basemap basemap)`](https://docs.example.com/flutter/api/harbor_maps/HarborChart/HarborChart.html) _(factory)_: Creates a chart on top of a basemap.

## Properties

- [`backgroundColor ↔ Color?`](https://docs.example.com/flutter/api/harbor_maps/HarborChart/backgroundColor.html) _(getter/setter pair)_: The colour drawn behind all layers.
- [`hashCode → int`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-core/Object/hashCode.html) _(no setter, inherited)_: The hash code for this object.

## Methods

- [`load() → Future<void>`](https://docs.example.com/flutter/api/harbor_maps/HarborChart/load.html): Loads the chart's layers.
